title: What It Takes: Oprah Winfrey, Part 1 (4/4)
titleZh: 成功的條件：歐普拉，第一部 (4/4)
summaryZh: 歐普拉回憶四年級開始相信自己，在學校模仿牧師講道，被取笑也不在意。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — What It Takes

sentences.text: In the fourth grade is when I first began to believe in myself.
sentences.zh: 四年級的時候，我第一次開始相信自己。

sentences.text: I, for the first time, believed that I could do almost anything.
sentences.zh: 我第一次相信自己幾乎什麼都做得到。

sentences.text: I felt I was the queen bee.
sentences.zh: 我覺得自己就像女王蜂一樣風光。

sentences.text: I felt I could control the world.
sentences.zh: 我覺得我可以掌控全世界。

sentences.text: I was going to be a missionary.
I was going to Costa Rica.
I was going to, I used to collect money on the playground to take to church on Sundays.
sentences.zh: 我打算，我以前都會在操場上跟人募款，禮拜天再帶去教會。

sentences.text: And at the time in schools, we had devotions.
sentences.zh: 那時候學校裡有靈修禱告的時間。

sentences.text: And I would sit and I would listen to everything the preacher said on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我會坐在那裡，把牧師禮拜天講的每一句話都聽進去。

sentences.text: And go back to school on Monday morning and beg Mrs. Duncan to please let me do the devotion.
sentences.zh: 然後禮拜一早上回到學校，拜託鄧肯老師讓我來帶靈修禱告。

sentences.text: Just sort of repeat the sermon.
sentences.zh: 就是把那篇講道再重講一次。

sentences.text: So in the fourth grade, I was called preacher.
sentences.zh: 所以四年級的時候，大家都叫我「小牧師」。

sentences.text: Kids used to poke fun at me all the time.
sentences.zh: 同學以前老是拿我開玩笑。

sentences.text: It didn't bother me because I was so inspired at the time.
sentences.zh: 我一點都不在意，因為那時候我整個人充滿了熱情。
